rows.summary: This update revises findings on intelligent disobedience and LLM reasoning blind spots, synthesizing evidence on heuristic search and decision-theoretic agents. It formalizes intelligent disobedience as the ability to reject locally optimal heuristic search paths and identifies 'blind spots' in LLM reasoning as structural failures in search space exploration, consistent with heuristic search limitations.
rows.title: Synthesis of Intelligent Disobedience and Reasoning Blind Spots

rows.summary: This proposal continues the investigation into LLM reasoning blind spots using newly retrieved EACL 2026 conference proceedings (source-05c989bd8c754010, source-762858f5b5974369, source-f1099bec88e640f9). We record our continuity status and advance our project research under the unrecognized reasoning limits topic.
